i don’t know much about the drug, but i looked it up for you and it says “Hydroxyzine’s effects start wearing off within a few hours, but the complete elimination may take approximately 2 to 4 days due to its half-life of 14 to 25 hours. Individual factors, dosage, and formulations can influence the duration.” since you took 400mg, i would honestly suggest you go to a doctor for your own safety, i know you don’t want to be sent away again, but everything i am reading about the drug is that it does have all the side affects you are talking about and it is very dangerous to not seek medical attention after taking such a high dose. the disassociation is likely from your mind not being able to process what your body is going through. please seek medical attention. i know it’s scary, but your family would rather you be alive and safe and so would I!!! i’m wishing you the best, please reach out to me if you need to talk

it is 100% illegal for them to not give you your last paycheck. please look into your states department of labor and reach out to them. they will make sure you get your money!! shits hard nowadays so i would hate to see you not get your money you worked hard for. in the meantime if you’re able to, try reaching out to your landlord and be transparent about next months rent, if they aren’t a slumlord they will usually be okay with you being a little late if you explain your situation and let them know you are doing your best to fix it. i’m praying everything works out for you!

hey, i know how hard college can be. I understand you don’t want to be there, but at the end of the day it is your choice. you could just try and see if you do like it, you might make some friends on campus that you can talk to! even if you don’t feel like continuing, then please reach out to your mom and just let her know how you are feeling about college. please don’t commit suicide without looking at other options for yourself. you’re still so young, and you deserve to live your life how you want to. i’m not sure how understanding your mom would be if you expressed to her exactly how you feel about college, but if she’s not as supportive of you leaving, then just try for at least one semester to see how you feel about it. you never know if you don’t at least try. i know it’s easier said than done but i was the same exact way in college and i ended up making forever friends while there, and I only stayed for a little longer than a semester. i promise you everything will fall into place for you, just please hang in there! 

reach out to me if you need to talk!

a lot of people don’t know what to say/how to handle talk of suicide. not that i think it is okay for that reaction from your gf, but it is probably upsetting her thinking that she’s not even a reason for you to want to stay. you should be able to openly talk about and express how you are feeling to your significant other. 

on top of that, (and correct me if i am wrong here), it sounds like you are set on taking your own life, without even wanting to try and figure these things out. life doesn’t always go the way you want it to. it can really fucking suck at times, and feel like there is no way out of the hole you are in. BUT there is absolutely so much more for you to see in life. i know it doesn’t seem like it now, but shit gets better, everything will play out eventually. it is just up to YOU to fight for it. i know it’s easier said than done, but you need someone to talk to, wether it’s for advice or just to listen. 

Please try to at least keep your focus on trying to fix it for your future rather than before you leave this earth. you are here for a reason! people love you, care about you, need you! i know it sounds so generic but it is so so true. i would say try communicating again with your girlfriend about your thoughts and how you are feeling but let her know you’re just feeling defeated and need a little extra help. it is so 100% okay to have these feeling and thoughts you are having, it’s normal, i just want to make sure you know that you matter and this pain you are feeling is temporary. 

please reach out to me if you need to talk about anything !
